verified_facts.text: Adare Manor is in the village of Adare, County Limerick, 25 minutes from Shannon Airport, on the Wild Atlantic Way.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just 25 minutes from Shannon Airport, and perfectly placed on The Wild Atlantic Way, Adare Manor is set in the storybook village of Adare, Co. Limerick.

verified_facts.text: The estate covers 840 acres of parkland.
verified_facts.excerpt: As you roam the 840 acres of pristine parkland

verified_facts.text: Construction of the neo-Gothic manor house began in 1832 and continued for over 30 years, completing in the 1860s.
verified_facts.excerpt: Construction of the current manor house began in 1832 and continued for over 30 years, completing in the 1860s.

verified_facts.text: The manor was built by the Quin family, later the Earls of Dunraven, led by the 2nd Earl and Lady Caroline Wyndham.
verified_facts.excerpt: The current manor was built by the Quin family, later known as the Earls of Dunraven. Windham Henry Quin, the 2nd Earl of Dunraven, and his wife Lady Caroline Wyndham led the creation of the manor in the 19th century

verified_facts.text: The Gallery, 132 feet 6 inches long, was the largest domestic room of its age in Ireland.
verified_facts.excerpt: At 132ft 6in long, 21ft wide and 21ft 6in high, the Gallery was the largest domestic room of its age in Ireland.

verified_facts.text: The rebuilding work continued through the Great Irish Famine, providing employment for local people.
verified_facts.excerpt: This key renovation continued throughout the Great Irish Famine, providing vital employment for local people

verified_facts.text: Adare Manor became a five-star hotel in 1988.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adare Manor becomes a 5 star hotel.

verified_facts.text: A transformative restoration was completed in 2017.
verified_facts.excerpt: a transformative restoration completed in 2017

verified_facts.text: The Dunraven Staterooms were once the private apartments of the Earls of Dunraven and their families, in the historic Manor House.
verified_facts.excerpt: Once the private apartments of the Earls of Dunraven and their families, these spectacular staterooms located in the historic Manor House

verified_facts.text: Rooms have marble en-suite bathrooms and historically inspired art and furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: gorgeous historically-inspired art and furnishings, marble en-suite bathrooms

verified_facts.text: Rose and Lavender Cottages are two three-bedroom self-catering cottages next to The Carriage House, a three-minute walk from the Manor House.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adare Manor is delighted to offer two three-bedroom storybook cottages on a self-catering basis. Perfectly situated right next to The Carriage House and only a three minute walk from the Manor House

verified_facts.text: Two- and four-bedroom Manor Lodges are offered as an independent alternative.
verified_facts.excerpt: our beautifully designed and furnished two and four bedroom Manor Lodges

verified_facts.text: Head Chef Michael Tweedie leads The Oak Room's seasonal menu of Irish artisan ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Michelin star Oak Room restaurant, where Head Chef Michael Tweedie’s seasonal menu has distilled the essence of Ireland’s best artisan ingredients

verified_facts.text: Ōku is the estate's newest restaurant, a Japanese sushi experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in an exceptional sushi experience at our newest dining destination, Ōku.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in The Gallery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Afternoon Tea in The Gallery is a refined indulgence

verified_facts.text: The Drawing Room overlooks the formal gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Drawing Room is a luxurious setting overlooking the beautiful formal gardens

verified_facts.text: The Tack Room is a bar with a whiskey collection, specialty cocktails and sharing platters.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Tack Room, where a menu of savoury snacks and sharing platters are the perfect companion to a world-class whiskey collection and specialty cocktail list

verified_facts.text: The Spa was the first in Ireland to offer customised facial and body treatments with 111SKIN products.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa at Adare Manor is the first spa in Ireland to offer customised treatments using 111SKIN products.

verified_facts.text: The Spa is reserved for hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa at Adare Manor is reserved for hotel guests.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments should be booked at the time of booking the stay or four to six weeks ahead.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is recommended to reserve treatments at the time of booking your stay or at least four to six weeks prior to your visit

verified_facts.text: The golf course was redesigned by golf architect Tom Fazio.
verified_facts.excerpt: Celebrated golf architect Tom Fazio has taken what was already an award-winning course and transformed it into a parkland paradise

verified_facts.text: Adare Manor will host the Ryder Cup from 13 to 19 September 2027.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adare Manor will host the Ryder Cup from 13–19 September 2027

verified_facts.text: The golf course typically operates from late May through mid-October.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Golf Course at Adare Manor typically operates from late May through mid-October each year

verified_facts.text: All golfers are required to use the caddie programme.
verified_facts.excerpt: All golfers are required to use our elite caddie programme

verified_facts.text: Estate activities include falconry, archery, axe throwing, clay pigeon shooting, fishing, cycling and horse-drawn carriage tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Outdoor pursuits include golf, cycling, falconry, fishing, archery, axe throwing, gundogs, clay pigeon shooting, horse and carriage tour and estate walks

verified_facts.text: A self-guided architecture and garden audio tour has versions for adults and for children aged 6 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dedicated versions of the audio tour are available for both adults and children aged 6–12

verified_facts.text: The Padel Club has a swimming pool, gym, studio and padel courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: fitness and leisure facilities at The Padel Club, which include swimming, gym and studio, and padel courts

verified_facts.text: The estate has a private cinema showing a History of Adare Manor film.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can also enjoy our History of Adare Manor film, shown in our private cinema

verified_facts.text: Most estate activities are reserved for guests staying at Adare Manor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most estate activities are reserved for guests staying at Adare Manor.

verified_facts.text: Children aged 6 and up are welcome at The Oak Room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children aged 6 and up are welcome.

verified_facts.text: The Duke and Duchess of York, later King George V, were entertained at Adare Manor in August 1897.
verified_facts.excerpt: He and his wife, the Duchess of York, were entertained at Adare Manor in August 1897.
